app: Actual frontend React App served by programmatic Vite createServer

api.mode: all /api/** requests intercepted; synthetic fixtures only; no backend, LLM, or secrets

limitations: @monaco-editor/react was replaced with a local read-only textarea stub to avoid CDN/network dependency; Monaco rendering, workers, and editor decorations were not exercised.

checks.name: search A then chat answer B replaces right references; all eight B links render on the left
clicking an older chat reference after a newer answer restores and selects the old reference list
reset search restores the latest non-empty chat answer
reset search restores latest empty chat answer rather than an earlier answer
changing projects clears prior chat and code references
a slow stale snippet cannot overwrite a newer selected snippet
snippet failure is rendered without an unhandled rejection
a delayed project A selection cannot override a later project B selection
